init.title: Local readings and heat estimation
init.description: Both features are optional and disabled by default. Local reads require an existing Bosch integration entry for the same gateway. Model values are estimates, separate from reported energy.

local.title: Local iCom gateway
local.description: Enter the LAN address or hostname only. Credentials are read from your matching Bosch integration entry, not copied into IVT options. Reads occur even if the cloud fails.

model.title: Heat-model inputs and assumptions
model.description: Select supply/return temperatures (°C or °F) and compressor modulation (%). Tank temperature is optional. Default rating COP 4.8 at B0/W35 and tank 180 L describe GEO 512C; check your appliance specification. Calibration is optional, uses vetted whole days, and is not an independent heat meter.

data.calibration_enabled: Enable guarded calibration against gateway heat recordings
data.reported_heat_includes_auxiliary: Gateway heat output includes auxiliary heat (calibration only)

error.model_requires_local: The heat model requires local readings to be enabled.
error.bosch_credentials_required: Configure the Bosch integration for the same gateway ID first. Its entry must contain local credentials.
error.invalid_host: Enter only a gateway IP address or hostname, without a URL path.
error.invalid_model_settings: Check the model limits and select distinct supply, return and modulation sensors with supported units. Temperature sensors need °C/°F and modulation needs %.
